prompt: Create a complete production 2D isometric RPG animation atlas STRICTLY based on the attached original character portrait. Preserve its exact design, silhouette, proportions, palette, face, clothing, equipment and limb anatomy. Same detailed small painted game-sprite style and elevated isometric viewpoint. Fully transparent RGBA background, no scenery, captions, grids or cast shadows. EXACTLY EIGHT COLUMNS and THIRTEEN ROWS = 104 separate whole articulated poses. Every complete character including wings and extended limbs must be SMALL, occupying at most 50 percent of the width and height of its cell. Large empty gutters, at least 25 pixels fully transparent on all sides of each pose and outer border. Never touch neighbors or clip body parts. Exact column direction order E, SE, S, SW, W, NW, N, NE. E is a strict right profile, SE front-right, S DIRECTLY FRONT facing the viewer, SW front-left, W strict left profile, NW back-left, N FULL BACK with no face visible, NE back-right. Do not reuse three-quarter front facing for side or rear directions. Keep each column's compass in every action. Rows exactly: 1 neutral idle; 2 visibly distinct breathing idle; 3 first walking/movement step; 4 passing movement phase; 5 opposite movement step; 6 attack windup; 7 attack CONTACT toward the facing direction; 8 attack recovery; 9 hit recoil; 10 hit recovery; 11 death buckling/falling begins; 12 falling close to ground; 13 final flat collapsed recognizable body, limbs connected. All 104 poses must be actually articulated and distinct, never repeated or merely translated. Constant whole-body scale throughout. Preserve this exact original HARPY with TWO long pale gray/white feathered wings forming its upper limbs, the original small pale head, dark brown compact body, and two ochre/golden avian legs ending in sharp talons. Keep the original face, feathers and dark torso as shown; do not invent a human bikini body, arms in addition to wings, weapons or accessories. It is an airborne feathered creature. Idle is hovering with two wing positions; movement rows are three visibly different wingbeat and leg-tuck phases, keeping body facing the column's direction. Attack windup raises legs/wings, contact rakes BOTH original talons forward in its facing direction, recovery draws the talons back. Wings stay anatomically attached and completely inside each cell. Hit folds/recoils wings; death descends and ends lying flat, wings folded at sides. No extra detached feathers or particles.

review.notes: Existing 1024.png identity retained: two long pale feathered upper-limb wings, small pale head, dark brown torso and two ochre avian talons. No extra human arms, costume or weapons. Different hover/flight wingbeats and talon rake, hit and connected collapse. Front and rear body anatomy stays distinct. Blue harpy is excluded because its current body metadata differs. Actual Main AI/projectiles/lifecycle must pass for every registered name before completion is counted.
